verdict.rationale: Vercel's first-party AI Gateway lets you call hundreds of models through one endpoint using the AI SDK, any OpenAI-compatible SDK, or cURL. It adds automatic fallbacks, spending controls and usage monitoring, so the builder never provisions GPUs or plans capacity. It is documented as usable from any cloud or infrastructure, but it routes to third-party providers rather than running inference on Vercel's own global edge. missing for 10: evidence of globally distributed, low-latency inference execution (edge/region placement of inference), independent or hands-on corroboration of the gateway's behavior.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can run AI model inference globally with a single call without managing GPUs or capacity planning

citations.quote: Call hundreds of models through one endpoint with the AI SDK, any OpenAI-compatible SDK, or cURL, with budgets, fallbacks, and usage monitoring.
Route AI requests across providers through Vercel AI Gateway from any cloud or language, with automatic fallbacks, prompt caching, spending controls, usage monitoring, and no markup on token prices.
Use one managed gateway from any infrastructure to centralize credentials, log requests, control spend, and fail over across providers.
